answer: By the falcon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A hollow of per-task receipts records who did what, and the meadow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a comparative analysis, benchmarks emphasized register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on retroactive public goods funding mechanisms.
